capture_ownership_contract: Protocol1 runtime generation identity; matching pending request for CPU frames; identity rechecked after copy. Filesystem timestamps are not ownership evidence.
first_screen_contract: Runtime execution, fresh guest frames and safe return; a recognizable application screen requires visual review. This does not prove gameplay.

observed_sessions.scope: Diagnostic observation; final launcher result is required to verify completion and installation identity.

latest_memory_admission.scope: parser estimate is admission accounting, not an allocator measurement; memory.log contains allocator snapshots

host_storage_preflight.scope: Host staging estimate, separate from guest/Horizon memory admission
